prompt:

Return a single JSON object with EXACTLY these fields:
- readinessScore (string): overall ISO readiness score
- gaps (string): identified gaps in current system
- recommendations (string): recommended actions to address gaps
- standards (string): applicable ISO standards

End your response with exactly one line: ANSWER: <your JSON object>
response: ANSWER: {"readinessScore":"Moderate","gaps":"Inconsistent sterilization records, high medication error rate, no centralized document control, outdated staff competency records","recommendations":"Implement a centralized electronic health record system, standardize sterilization protocols, enhance medication error tracking, establish a centralized document control system, update staff competency records","standards":"ISO 9001, ISO 13485, ISO 15189"}
